name: vllm-glm51
about: GLM-5.1-FP8 disaggregated stack: MoRI 624002c, AITER with the ROCm/aiter#4957 gqa64 fix, vLLM for GLM-5.1, vllm-router; MoRI-EP only by default.

aiter.why: AITER with ROCm/aiter#4957 (gqa64). Personal fork until #4957 is in an AITER release.

vllm.why: vLLM for GLM-5.1 disaggregated serving. Personal fork.

router.why: vllm-router with DP-rank round-robin (11841c0d) and the 2P2D KV-notify fix (remote_dp_rank_override + remote_dp_size); without the latter 2P2D EP=16 wedges with 'remote blocks never arrived'. Personal fork until vllm-project/router PR #181 lands.

transports.why: UCX + RIXL (+python) + rocSHMEM + DeepEP for the rixl connector (NIXL TP, DeepEP wideEP). Off builds a MoRI-EP-only image.

rocshmem.why: Parent of rocm-systems 16dc5673 (2026-09-25), whose scoped float/double atomics this ROCm 7.2 compiler rejects; the rocSHMEM these images last built with. The legacy GLM image cloned rocm-systems develop, which no longer builds; the stack is off by default there.

deepep.why: the legacy images cloned the default branch with no ref; its tip on 2026-11-03 (last commit 2026-06-30)
